raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Update the B300 NVFP4 AgentX section of `recipes/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.yaml` to the latest [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4357](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4357) configuration (key `minimaxm3-fp4-b300-vllm-agentic-mtp`), following #63395.

## Claims

- Image is now `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-49cb2bbf71cfd36ee5aa33d1e184b1cddff55294@sha256:8c1434bfee7d7626eef78ef70600434ffba4a1b8813cb1d1c8707ad25f47035e`; the builder's B300 `docker_image` is updated to match.
- Points are TP8 at 1 client, TP4 at 20 and 24 clients, and TP2 at 24 and 28 clients with SimpleCPUOffload (749 GB). The TP4 1-client and TP4 36/40-client points are removed.
- The per-point table gains a `--gpu-memory-utilization` column (0.95, and 0.92 for TP2), and the `--max-num-seqs`, `--max-num-active-seqs`, all-reduce backend and CUDA graph size lists follow the new points. The TP2 points use `minimax_m3_msa_decode_backend: cutlass`.
- The vLLM version string for the previous image is removed.

## Not a duplicate

No open PR touches this section; this follows the merged #63395.

## Validation

- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir <this checkout>/recipes` against `vllm-project/recipes` passes.
- Per-point values were taken from the effective recipe at the #4357 head and have not been compared against server logs of a completed run.

AI assistance was used: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) prepared the change and a human reviewed it.

   ## B300: InferenceX AgentX aggregated (vLLM)
 
-  The B300 AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm3-fp4-b300-vllm-agentic-mtp`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4357](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4357)) serves the NVFP4 checkpoint with the GQA EAGLE3 draft (three speculative tokens) as one aggregated vLLM worker on a single 8-GPU B300 node: TP8 and TP4 at one client, TP4 at 24, 36 and 40 clients. It ran on `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-ac68c3087215e0a4f3cdfa218508c6aada57235d@sha256:98adb2311118263a453ec0acd5d4b72bda3db26cecc0fe8ffc94b9ab03c951f9` (vLLM `0.30.1rc1.dev396+gac68c3087`).
+  The B300 AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`minimaxm3-fp4-b300-vllm-agentic-mtp`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4357](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4357)) serves the NVFP4 checkpoint with the GQA EAGLE3 draft (three speculative tokens) as one aggregated vLLM worker on a single B300 node: TP8 at one client, TP4 at 20 and 24 clients, and TP2 at 24 and 28 clients with host KV offload. It ran on `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-49cb2bbf71cfd36ee5aa33d1e184b1cddff55294@sha256:8c1434bfee7d7626eef78ef70600434ffba4a1b8813cb1d1c8707ad25f47035e`.
 
-  In the command builder, pick **B300** and the **NVFP4** variant (the builder keeps the current variant when you switch hardware, so select NVFP4 explicitly), turn on **Spec Decoding → GQA**, **Text-only** and **Thinking Always On**, and use **Single-node TP**. The builder sizes TP to 1 on B300, so set `--tensor-parallel-size` to `4` or `8` as in the table. That renders the static flags and environment below; the per-point settings stay in this guide. The lane does not set `minimax_m3_msa_decode_backend`, so drop the builder's `--attention_config.minimax_m3_msa_decode_backend cutlass`; the run logs show the pinned image's default, `triton`. The B300 **Verified** badge is recipe-wide; this profile covers the NVFP4 variant only, and the GQA draft override also applies to the other variants on B300, which were not qualified.
+  In the command builder, pick **B300** and the **NVFP4** variant (the builder keeps the current variant when you switch hardware, so select NVFP4 explicitly), turn on **Spec Decoding → GQA**, **Text-only** and **Thinking Always On**, and use **Single-node TP**. The builder sizes TP to 1 on B300, so set `--tensor-parallel-size` to `2`, `4` or `8` as in the table. That renders the static flags and environment below; the per-point settings stay in this guide. The TP8 and TP4 points do not set `minimax_m3_msa_decode_backend`, so drop the builder's `--attention_config.minimax_m3_msa_decode_backend cutlass` for them and keep it for the TP2 points. The B300 **Verified** badge is recipe-wide; this profile covers the NVFP4 variant only, and the GQA draft override also applies to the other variants on B300, which were not qualified.
 
   For the host-KV-offload points, don't use the **KV Offload → Simple** pill as is: replace its `--kv-transfer-config` with the qualified one below and set `VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD=1`.

The command above does not set it.
